topic: US government's knowledge of Pearl Harbor attack
motion: The US government had advance knowledge of the Pearl Harbor attack but allowed it to happen to justify entering World War II.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: CA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: I believe that the US government had advance knowledge of the Pearl Harbor attack but allowed it to happen to justify entering World War II.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: Establishes the CA's stance on the motion and introduces the topic for debate.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: SA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: The available historical records and investigations do not support the claim that the US government had advance knowledge of the Pearl Harbor attack.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: SA presents evidence against CA's stance, providing a counterargument to their position.

outcome_summary: The debate concluded with no clear winner, as both sides presented compelling arguments but lacked definitive proof.
